_comment_roles: Matches docs/architecture/11-security-architecture.md §11.2's RBAC role list exactly. Add a new role here in the same PR as adding it to that document, per docs/repo-audit/05-development-guidelines.md §5.5.

realm.name: entrepreneurship_officer
realm.description: Day-to-day case owner; can initiate and approve within assigned branch/state (ABAC-scoped).

realm.name: branch_manager
realm.description: Escalation target above case-owner exposure threshold; blocked-workflow manual override.

realm.name: auditor
realm.description: Read-only, cross-workflow Audit Service access. Reads are themselves logged (docs/architecture/08-memory-architecture.md §8.6).

realm.name: administrator
realm.description: User/role/agent/tool configuration. Grants require dual-control per docs/architecture/review/05-mvp-and-final-decision.md §12.2 item 10.

clients.name: MARA AI-ETC Officer Workspace
clients.description: apps/officer-workspace/ — public SPA client, authorization code + PKCE flow.

clients.name: MARA AI-ETC API Gateway
clients.description: services/api_gateway/ — confidential client, token introspection only.

requiredActions.name: Configure OTP
requiredActions._comment: MFA is non-negotiable for any role with approval authority (docs/architecture/11-security-architecture.md §11.2). Enforced per-role via a client scope / conditional flow — not enabled by default for every account so dev accounts stay usable, per configs/dev/settings.toml's mfa_required=false. Set defaultAction true and mfa_required=true before staging/production import.
